```{r}
#| eval: false
floraR::flora_get_descriptions()
```

### Description

Downloads printable PDF versions of Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB) taxon pages
for a set of species and extracts text from the description sections. The
function attempts to recover two kinds of descriptions from each page:
controlled descriptions ("Descricao com campos controlados") and free
descriptions ("Descricao livre").

### Details

For each taxon, the function:

1. builds a printable page URL from the `references` column;
2. saves the page temporarily as `temp.pdf`;
3. extracts text with pdftools;
4. searches for the controlled-description section;
5. searches for the free-description section;
6. stores extracted text in named lists using the scientific name.

Failed extractions are returned together with the extracted descriptions.

The function assumes that the printable FFB page contains recognizable
section headers in Portuguese and/or English, such as:

- `"Descricao com campos controlados|Description with controlled"`
- `"Descricao livre|Free description"`
- `"Comentarios|Commentaries"`
- `"Vouchers"`
- `"Origem|Origin"`
- `"Bibliografia Referencia|Reference"`

Text is extracted from the first PDF page only. Temporary output is always
written to a file named `temp.pdf` in the working directory.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| taxa | A data frame containing the taxa to process. It must include at least the columns `genus`, `specificEpithet`, and `references`. Each row is treated as one taxon page to download and parse. |
| delay | Numeric. Delay in seconds passed to `webshot::webshot()` to allow the page to load before the PDF is captured. Default is `10`. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints informative progress messages during parsing. If `FALSE`, runs quietly. |

### Value

A named list with two elements:

  `descriptions_controlled`A named list of controlled
  descriptions. If any failures occur, this element becomes a list of length
  two: extracted descriptions and a character vector of failed taxon names.
  `descriptions_free`A named list of free descriptions. If any
  failures occur, this element becomes a list of length two: extracted
  descriptions and a character vector of failed taxon names.

### Examples

```r
taxa <- flora_records(taxon = "Luetzelburgia",
                      taxonomicStatus = "NOME_ACEITO")

descriptions <- flora_get_descriptions(taxa, delay = 10)
```
